title: Use Group X – Production Uses
previewText:

blocks.html: The provisions of Section 42-202, except as otherwise specified in such Sections, may be modified by special permit of the Board of Standards and Appeals, in accordance with Section 73-211 (Production uses), or by special permit of the City Planning Commission, in accordance with Section 74-211 (Production uses).
